run_wikibio_k_shot_generation: run the WikiBio dataset to generate 32-shot train dev and test splits for multiple random seeds
create_wikibio_dataset_instance: create a WikiBio dataset instance that loads the wiki_bio HuggingFace dataset for text to text tasks
build_input_text_from_datapoint: build an input text string from a WikiBio datapoint by combining context and table columns with separators
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input text and target text tuples for WikiBio
get_train_test_lines: get shuffled train and test line lists from the WikiBio dataset using 1 percent of validation data
